stage_transitions_note_required.name: stage_transitions_note_required
stage_transitions_note_required.value: "stage_transitions"."kind" NOT IN ('advance_with_exception', 'regress') OR ("stage_transitions"."note" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("stage_transitions"."note") <> '')

curriculum_nodes_numbers_check.name: curriculum_nodes_numbers_check
curriculum_nodes_numbers_check.value:
("curriculum_nodes"."expected_days" IS NULL OR "curriculum_nodes"."expected_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 3650)
      AND ("curriculum_nodes"."due_offset_days" IS NULL OR "curriculum_nodes"."due_offset_days" BETWEEN 0 AND 3650)

program_runs_dates_check.name: program_runs_dates_check
program_runs_dates_check.value: "program_runs"."ends_on" IS NULL OR "program_runs"."starts_on" IS NULL OR "program_runs"."ends_on" >= "program_runs"."starts_on"

program_templates_numbers_check.name: program_templates_numbers_check
program_templates_numbers_check.value:
("program_templates"."session_quota" IS NULL OR "program_templates"."session_quota" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000)
        AND ("program_templates"."session_minutes" IS NULL OR "program_templates"."session_minutes" BETWEEN 5 AND 600)
        AND ("program_templates"."validity_days" IS NULL OR "program_templates"."validity_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 3650)
        AND ("program_templates"."duration_weeks" IS NULL OR "program_templates"."duration_weeks" BETWEEN 1 AND 520)

run_nodes_numbers_check.name: run_nodes_numbers_check
run_nodes_numbers_check.value:
("run_nodes"."expected_days" IS NULL OR "run_nodes"."expected_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 3650)
      AND ("run_nodes"."due_offset_days" IS NULL OR "run_nodes"."due_offset_days" BETWEEN 0 AND 3650)

students_scales_check.name: students_scales_check
students_scales_check.value:
("students"."skill_level" IS NULL OR "students"."skill_level" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
        AND ("students"."english_writing" IS NULL OR "students"."english_writing" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
        AND ("students"."english_speaking" IS NULL OR "students"."english_speaking" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)

students_numbers_check.name: students_numbers_check
students_numbers_check.value:
("students"."hours_per_week" IS NULL OR "students"."hours_per_week" BETWEEN 0 AND 168)
        AND ("students"."income_goal_usd" IS NULL OR "students"."income_goal_usd" >= 0)

tasks_cancel_reason_check.name: tasks_cancel_reason_check
tasks_cancel_reason_check.value: "tasks"."status" <> 'cancelled' OR ("tasks"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("tasks"."cancel_reason") <> '')
